name: Zhejiang Xianju Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Xianju Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of steroid raw materials and preparations in China and internationally. The company offers cortical steriod, gynecology and family planning, respiratory, and dermatological drugs, as well as anaesthetic and muscle relaxants; and active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates. It is also involved in the provision of contract development and manufacturing organization; contract manufacturing organization; technical; technology development; and inspection and testing services. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Xianju, China.
